name: session-toc
description: A clickable table of contents of the whole current session: topics grouped by category, with timestamps, in a pane

wrapText.title: Wrap long descriptions
wrapText.description: Show the full text of every topic, summary and message on several lines instead of cutting it to one line

autoGroupEvery.title: Group new messages automatically after
autoGroupEvery.description: New messages appear in the pane by themselves as you talk (no Claude call). Once this many are waiting ungrouped, one small Claude call files them into topics. 0 = only when you press Refresh.
